title: Torreon: Bato dela Rosa has not abandoned his office
summary: Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa"s counsel said that he has "not abandoned" his office amid an ethics complaint over his prolonged absence.

blocks.text: Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa’s counsel said that he has "not abandoned" his office amid an ethics complaint over his prolonged absence.

“Senator Dela Rosa has not abandoned his office. His office remains open, fully staffed, and working. He is not attending in person only because he faces arrest and surrender to a foreign tribunal on a warrant whose enforceability in the Philippines is still pending before the Supreme Court,” Dela Rosa’s counsel Israelito Torreon said.
The senator has not been publicly seen since 2025, aside from a brief appearance at the Upper Chamber in May.

“The Senate itself placed him under protective custody while he exhausts his legal remedies, and those remedies are still pending. We are confident that the Committee will decide this matter on the basis of its Rules and the evidence,” he added.
Torreon also said that Dela Rosa could only be disciplined for a rule that existed. The Committee’s Rules said that it did not have jurisdiction as "no rule has been violated."
Dela Rosa’s counsel maintained that while the Senate Ethics Committee found the complaint sufficient in form, it was only done so that the complaint could be sent to the senator.
“It is not a finding that Senator Dela Rosa violated any rule, and it was made before he had been heard,” Torreon said.

Dela Rosa’s office received the Committee’s notice on November 19 and acknowledged it on the same day. Torreon said that they have responded and asked if there were other affidavits coming, since only five out of the nine complainants submitted affidavits.
“Senator Dela Rosa will file his answer within the period the Committee has given, and will ask that the complaint be dismissed,” Torreon said.

Since reports circulated that the International Criminal Court has issued an arrest warrant for him in 2025, Dela Rosa has been on the run. He is accused of committing crimes against humanity in relation to the bloody war on drugs during former president Rodrigo Duterte’s term, which killed at least 6,000 people. --VAL GMA News
